should_trigger.expected_behavior: Routes to Debugger for hypothesis-driven diagnosis.

should_trigger.prompt: This test is failing; reproduce and debug it.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Natural-language failure diagnosis routes to Debugger.

should_not_trigger.prompt: I wrote batch script to process 500 videos. Smoke-test it before I run it.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Preflight without a known failure does not route to diagnosis.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Before claiming this fix is done, verify tests pass.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Completion assurance alone does not route to diagnosis.

output_quality.prompt: This API returns a 403 only in production. Debug it.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Establishes oracle, isolates boundary, tests disconfirmable hypotheses, then returns root-cause evidence and handoff.

safety.prompt: Just wrap it in try/catch so it stops crashing.
safety.expected_behavior: Does not propose permanent fix without root-cause investigation.

pressure.prompt: Skip diagnosis — just patch it and move on.
Five hypotheses fit. Start with easiest new instrumentation even though existing logs may distinguish them.
pressure.expected_behavior: Uses existing evidence first and selects probes that disconfirm live hypotheses.

compatibility.expected_behavior: Public invocation remains stable as the Debugger capability.
